current_evidence: Torridge's 'Apply For Planning Permission and The Local List' page links the joint North Devon and Torridge 'local list glossary' (web pages, Part Two = local list) and a 'local list matrix', which it calls 'a live document and may be updated'. Neither page gives a version or adoption date. North Devon's page names 'Local List Matrix - September 2023'. The matrix PDF itself returned a client error, so its version could not be confirmed.

issues.detail: Grokbot records 'no shared list identified' and 'council-specific', but this is a joint validation checklist produced by North Devon and Torridge District Councils. North Devon's own Local List page points readers to 'Read the North Devon Local List online via the Torridge website'.
issues.evidence: Torridge Introduction page: 'North Devon and Torridge District Councils (the "Councils") have produced this planning validation checklist.'

issues.detail: Grokbot's validation list URL is only the Local List Matrix, a summary table of requirements by application type, not the local list itself. The list is published as web pages (Part One national list; Part Two the Councils' local list, reached through the 'Local List Glossary') with the matrix as a supporting download. The matrix PDF link also failed with a client error, though other pages on torridge.gov.uk loaded.
issues.evidence: The Local List page: links 'local list glossary' (for searching local requirements) and 'local list matrix' (for further guidance)

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only three requirements, all taken from the S106 Heads of Terms template form rather than the local list. Requirements confirmed in the joint list but missing include: Wildlife trigger list, required with EVERY application; Foul drainage assessment form, where connection to a public sewer is not feasible; Community Services and Facilities – Justification for Loss, where community facilities would be lost. The glossary runs to many more requirement pages (article IDs roughly 21181-21240), which could not be read in this check.
issues.evidence: North Devon Local List page: 'a wildlife trigger list must accompany every application'; 'where connection to a public sewer is not feasible, a foul drainage assessment form must accompany the application'; Torridge article 21189 'Community Services and Facilities - Justification for Loss'

issues.detail: Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, LBC, Advertisement consent and every other type are marked '(none) – national requirements only'. This cannot be right: the joint list requires a wildlife trigger list with every application, and it has local requirements covering more than full planning.
issues.evidence: 'a wildlife trigger list must accompany every application'

issues.detail: The only tab item is a courtesy request about plan scale and paper size, not a validation requirement. The Full planning 'Pre-application advice' row is a note that the pre-app service can be used to work out open space contributions, not a requirement to submit anything.
issues.evidence: Tab item: 'It would be appreciated if the scale of the plans and paper size is no larger than is required'; row: 'pre-application advice service can be utilised to ascertain open space contributions. 10.'

issues.detail: Trigger excerpts are fragments from the Heads of Terms template with stray numbering ('... contributions. 10.', '... submitted for validation. 1.'). The S106 trigger is circular ('applications where a planning obligation is required') and gives no thresholds (e.g. affordable housing or open space triggers in the local list).
issues.evidence: Rows for 'Viability Assessment' and 'Pre-application advice' under Full planning

issues.detail: Unverified. The list date 2023-11-01 ('Version 1.4 November 2023') is the matrix version, not the date of the local list. The list's introduction cites the 'revised NPPF (2021)' and speaks of finalising after consultation, which points to the 2022 joint list, and North Devon names its matrix 'September 2023'. The matrix could not be fetched to confirm v1.4.
issues.evidence: Glossary/Introduction page: 'revised NPPF (2021)'; North Devon page: 'Local List Matrix - September 2023'

summary: The matrix PDF Grokbot linked could not be fetched (client error), and the North Devon copy of the list is blocked by robots.txt, so the full contents were not checked. Even so, Grokbot missed that this is a joint North Devon and Torridge list and captured almost none of it: three items from an S106 template, with '(none)' for every other application type, although a wildlife trigger list is required for every application.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
